title: catalyst — weekend

phrases.translation: 废催化剂；用过的催化剂

sentences.sentence: I very much hope that this case will prove to be a catalyst for change.
sentences.translation: 我非常希望这件事终将成为促成变化的催化剂。

sentences.translation: 这些植物中有些是国家珍品。

sentences.sentence: Protection of the vital oil fields remained a unifying goal, and the United States viewed a more capable Saudi military, one able to fend off regional and domestic threats, as key to attaining it.
sentences.translation: 保护重要石油地区的安全是两国统一的目标，而美军认为一个能够抵御地区和国内威胁的更加强大的沙特军队，是实现这一目标的关键。

phrases.translation: 收款人姓名；受益人名称

sentences.translation: 前总统被认为是早期选举的主要受益者之一。

sentences.sentence: Campaigners handed out leaflets on passive smoking.
sentences.translation: 发起人分发了关于被动吸烟的传单。

sentences.sentence: "It will only be a good idea to know your APOE genotype when there's something we can do about it, " she says.
sentences.translation: “只有当我们可以做出改变的时候，知道你的载脂蛋白E基因才 会是一件好事”，她说。

sentences.sentence: A common problem in studies attempting to relate genetics with a particular behavior is that a particular genotype might only confer a very small risk.
sentences.translation: 在试图将遗传学与特定行为联系起来的研究中，一般的问题是一个特定的基因型可能只造成一丁点风险。

sentences.sentence: The software analyzes the person’s HIV genotype and his or her current health characteristics against an evolving database of treatment outcomes for more than 33,000 patients and 98,000 therapies.
sentences.translation: 该软件能够针对超过98 000病人和 33 000治疗不断变化的治疗结果的数据库，以及他或她目前的健康规格参数，分析人的艾滋病毒基因型。

phrases.translation: 经济适用房；可支付住宅

sentences.translation: …多数人支付得起的房产的供应。

sentences.sentence: Objective To review the experience in the diagnosis and surgical treatment of cardiac myxoma.
sentences.translation: 目的探讨心脏黏液瘤的诊断和外科治疗。

sentences.sentence: Objective: To evaluate the implication of coronary arteriography in diagnosis of left atrial myxoma (LAM).
sentences.translation: 目的：评价冠状动脉（冠脉）造影对左房粘液瘤（LAM）诊断的意义。

sentences.sentence: Objective To analyse the clinical characteristics of the patients with embolic cerebrovascular disease caused by cardiac myxoma.
sentences.translation: 目的分析心脏粘液瘤致栓塞性脑血管病患者的临床特点。

translations.translation: 答复, 答辩v答复, 回击

sentences.sentence: I tried calling, but there was no reply.
sentences.translation: 我试着打电话去，但没有人接。

sentences.sentence: Stephen made no reply .
sentences.translation: 斯蒂芬没有回答。

sentences.sentence: We should stop the importation of these birds which are sold as commodities and endure lives of boredom in cages.
sentences.translation: 这种作为商品出售的鸟被关在笼子里忍耐着无聊的生活，我们应当停止它的进口。

sentences.sentence: While not legally binding the new levels allow countries to refuse to allow the importation of products with excessive levels of melamine.
sentences.translation: 这一最新含量虽然不具法律约束力，但可使各国政府拒绝进口三聚氰胺含量过高的产品。

phrases.translation: deny someone something 拒绝给予

sentences.sentence: The government denied the existence of poverty among 16- and 17-year-olds.
sentences.translation: 政府否认十六七岁的青少年当中存在贫困问题。

translations.translation: 苦心经营, 详尽的细节

sentences.sentence: The short answer will to power requires some elaboration as to the methods whereby one might effect such a transformation of ones experience.
sentences.translation: 简短的回答能够激励出苦心经营的需要,至于人们如何影响这样一种,个人经历的转变的方法。

sentences.sentence: congenital abnormalities
sentences.translation: 先天畸形

sentences.sentence: a congenital defect
sentences.translation: 先天性缺陷

sentences.sentence: Different photodissociation spectra, the action spectrum as function of laser wavelength, and ratio curve of different channels were obtained.
sentences.translation: 得到了反应的光解谱和作为波长函数的光解行为光谱以及各反应通道的分支比。

sentences.sentence: The oxygen in the atmosphere had to come from another source. The likely possibility involves the photodissociation of water vapor by high energy rays from the sun.
sentences.translation: 大气中的氧气必须从其它途径获取，很可能是光解作用，即由太阳反射的高能射线分解水蒸汽。

sentences.sentence: Don’t worry about Kurt; he’s a survivor.
sentences.translation: 不用担心库尔特，他是个坚强的人。

sentences.translation: 杳无人迹的荒岛

sentences.sentence: Anyway, Moran sat down at her computer and looked through the aphid genome for the genes that are responsible for carotenoids.
sentences.translation: 无论你听说过没有，现在，莫兰正坐在她的电脑前，研究蚜虫基因组的资料，查找负责类胡萝卜素的基因。

sentences.sentence: "And the big thing that made a difference in the ability to find that out was the genome sequence of the aphid was completed recently, " she says.
sentences.translation: “最近完成的蚜虫基因组序列计划是一件大事情，它让我们的研究能力获得极大提高，”她说。

sentences.sentence: Are you doing anything nice this weekend?
sentences.translation: 这个周末你有什么好的安排？

sentences.sentence: Tony has been unwell over the weekend (= during the weekend ).
sentences.translation: 托尼这个周末身体不舒服。

sentences.sentence: We’re going to Paris for a long weekend (= Saturday and Sunday, and also Friday or Monday, or both ).
sentences.translation: 我们要到巴黎去度一个长周末。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 326 单元

catalyst
音标：英 /'kæt(ə)lɪst/  美 /'kætəlɪst/
n. 催化剂
短语：phase transfer catalyst — 相转移催化剂
短语：hydrogenation catalyst — 加氢催化剂
短语：catalyst bed — 催化剂床
短语：catalyst carrier — n. 催化剂载体
短语：ammonia synthesis catalyst — 氨合成催化剂
短语：catalyst support — 催化剂载体
短语：zeolite catalyst — 沸石催化剂
短语：spent catalyst — 废催化剂；用过的催化剂
短语：oxidation catalyst — 氧化催化剂
短语：homogeneous catalyst — 均相催化剂
短语：heterogeneous catalyst — 非均相催化剂；多相催化；不匀触媒
短语：platinum catalyst — 铂催化剂
短语：dehydrogenation catalyst — 脱氢催化剂
短语：polymerization catalyst — [化]聚合催化剂
短语：catalyst poisoning — 催化剂中毒
例句：I very much hope that this case will prove to be a catalyst for change.
我非常希望这件事终将成为促成变化的催化剂。

rarity
音标：英 /'reərɪtɪ/  美 /'rɛrəti/
n. 稀有
例句：Some of these plants are national rarities.
这些植物中有些是国家珍品。

fend
音标：英 /fend/  美 /fend/
v. 保护, 供养
短语：fend off — v. 避开；挡开
短语：fend for oneself — 照料自己
短语：fend for — 照料；抚养
例句：Protection of the vital oil fields remained a unifying goal, and the United States viewed a more capable Saudi military, one able to fend off regional and domestic threats, as key to attaining it.
保护重要石油地区的安全是两国统一的目标，而美军认为一个能够抵御地区和国内威胁的更加强大的沙特军队，是实现这一目标的关键。

beneficiary
音标：英 /benɪ'fɪʃ(ə)rɪ/  美 /,bɛnɪ'fɪʃɪɛri/
n. 受惠者, 受益人
短语：beneficiary name — 收款人姓名；受益人名称
例句：One of the main beneficiaries of the early election is thought to be the former president.
前总统被认为是早期选举的主要受益者之一。

leaflet
音标：英 /ˈliːflət/  美 /'liflət/
n. 小叶, 传单
例句：Campaigners handed out leaflets on passive smoking.
发起人分发了关于被动吸烟的传单。

genotype
音标：英 /'dʒenətaɪp; 'dʒiːn-/  美 /'dʒɛno,taɪp/
n. 基因型
例句："It will only be a good idea to know your APOE genotype when there's something we can do about it, " she says.
“只有当我们可以做出改变的时候，知道你的载脂蛋白E基因才 会是一件好事”，她说。
例句：A common problem in studies attempting to relate genetics with a particular behavior is that a particular genotype might only confer a very small risk.
在试图将遗传学与特定行为联系起来的研究中，一般的问题是一个特定的基因型可能只造成一丁点风险。
例句：The software analyzes the person’s HIV genotype and his or her current health characteristics against an evolving database of treatment outcomes for more than 33,000 patients and 98,000 therapies.
该软件能够针对超过98 000病人和 33 000治疗不断变化的治疗结果的数据库，以及他或她目前的健康规格参数，分析人的艾滋病毒基因型。

affordable
音标：英 /ə'fɔːdəbəl/  美 /ə'fɔrdəbl/
adj. 负担得起的
短语：affordable price — 可承受价
短语：affordable housing — 经济适用房；可支付住宅
短语：economically affordable housing — 经济适用房
例句：...the availability of affordable housing.
…多数人支付得起的房产的供应。

myxoma
音标：英 /mɪk'səʊmə/  美 /mɪk'somə/
n. [医]粘液瘤
例句：Objective To review the experience in the diagnosis and surgical treatment of cardiac myxoma.
目的探讨心脏黏液瘤的诊断和外科治疗。
例句：Objective: To evaluate the implication of coronary arteriography in diagnosis of left atrial myxoma (LAM).
目的：评价冠状动脉（冠脉）造影对左房粘液瘤（LAM）诊断的意义。
例句：Objective To analyse the clinical characteristics of the patients with embolic cerebrovascular disease caused by cardiac myxoma.
目的分析心脏粘液瘤致栓塞性脑血管病患者的临床特点。

reply
音标：英 /rɪ'plaɪ/  美 /rɪ'plai/
n. 答复, 答辩v答复, 回击
短语：in reply — 作为答复
短语：no reply — 无回答，无应答
短语：reply for — 代表…作答
短语：reply immediately — 速复
短语：new reply — 新回复
例句：I tried calling, but there was no reply.
我试着打电话去，但没有人接。
例句：Stephen made no reply .
斯蒂芬没有回答。

importation
音标：英 /,ɪmpɔː'teɪʃən/  美 /,impɔ:'teiʃən/
n. 进口, 输入品
例句：We should stop the importation of these birds which are sold as commodities and endure lives of boredom in cages.
这种作为商品出售的鸟被关在笼子里忍耐着无聊的生活，我们应当停止它的进口。
例句：While not legally binding the new levels allow countries to refuse to allow the importation of products with excessive levels of melamine.
这一最新含量虽然不具法律约束力，但可使各国政府拒绝进口三聚氰胺含量过高的产品。

deny
音标：英 /dɪ'naɪ/  美 /dɪ'nai/
v. 否认, 拒绝
短语：deny oneself — 节制；戒除
短语：deny something to someone — deny someone something 拒绝给予
短语：deny access — 拒绝访问；不让进入
例句：The government denied the existence of poverty among 16- and 17-year-olds.
政府否认十六七岁的青少年当中存在贫困问题。

intaglio
音标：英 /ɪn'tælɪəʊ; -'tɑːl-/
n. 凹雕, 阴雕vt凹雕
短语：intaglio printing — （手工雕刻）凹版印刷；线雕凹印；雕刻印刷

elaboration
音标：英 /ɪ,læbə'reɪʃən/  美 /ɪ,læbə'reʃən/
n. 苦心经营, 详尽的细节
例句：The short answer will to power requires some elaboration as to the methods whereby one might effect such a transformation of ones experience.
简短的回答能够激励出苦心经营的需要,至于人们如何影响这样一种,个人经历的转变的方法。

congenital
音标：英 /kən'dʒenɪt(ə)l/  美 /kən'dʒɛnɪtl/
adj. 先天的,天生的,天赋的
短语：congenital heart disease — 先天性心脏病
短语：congenital malformation — 先天畸形
短语：congenital anomaly — 先天性异常
短语：congenital defect — 先天性缺陷（等于birth defect）
例句：congenital abnormalities
先天畸形
例句：a congenital defect
先天性缺陷

blockage
音标：英 /'blɒkɪdʒ/  美 /'blɑkɪdʒ/
n. 封锁, 妨碍

photodissociation
音标：英 /'fəʊtə(ʊ)dɪ,səʊʃɪ'eɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,fotodɪ,sosi'eʃɪn/
n. [物][化]光离解,光解 (作用)
例句：Different photodissociation spectra, the action spectrum as function of laser wavelength, and ratio curve of different channels were obtained.
得到了反应的光解谱和作为波长函数的光解行为光谱以及各反应通道的分支比。
例句：The oxygen in the atmosphere had to come from another source. The likely possibility involves the photodissociation of water vapor by high energy rays from the sun.
大气中的氧气必须从其它途径获取，很可能是光解作用，即由太阳反射的高能射线分解水蒸汽。

survivor
音标：英 /sə'vaɪvə/  美 /sɚ'vaɪvɚ/
n. 生还者, 残存物
例句：Don’t worry about Kurt; he’s a survivor.
不用担心库尔特，他是个坚强的人。

uninhabited
音标：英 /ʌnɪn'hæbɪtɪd/  美 /,ʌnɪn'hæbɪtɪd/
adj. 无人居住的,杳无人迹的
例句：an uninhabited island
杳无人迹的荒岛

aphid
音标：英 /'eɪfɪd/
n. [动]蚜虫
例句：Anyway, Moran sat down at her computer and looked through the aphid genome for the genes that are responsible for carotenoids.
无论你听说过没有，现在，莫兰正坐在她的电脑前，研究蚜虫基因组的资料，查找负责类胡萝卜素的基因。
例句："And the big thing that made a difference in the ability to find that out was the genome sequence of the aphid was completed recently, " she says.
“最近完成的蚜虫基因组序列计划是一件大事情，它让我们的研究能力获得极大提高，”她说。

weekend
音标：英 /wiːkˈɛnd/  美 /ˈwikend/
n. 周末, 周末休假 a周末的
短语：last weekend — 上周末
短语：at the weekend — 在周末
短语：over the weekend — 在周末；整个周末；经过周末
短语：on the weekend — 在周末
短语：on weekend — 在周末
短语：at weekend — 在周末
短语：have a nice weekend — 周末玩得愉快
短语：have a good weekend — 周末愉快
短语：weekend party — 周末派对
短语：weekend activities — 周末活动
例句：Are you doing anything nice this weekend?
这个周末你有什么好的安排？
例句：Tony has been unwell over the weekend (= during the weekend ).
托尼这个周末身体不舒服。
例句：We’re going to Paris for a long weekend (= Saturday and Sunday, and also Friday or Monday, or both ).
我们要到巴黎去度一个长周末。
